svg.aria-label: Two Terraform roots, one facts document
svg.title: Two Terraform roots, one facts document
svg.text: Two Terraform roots, one facts document
The foundation and the workloads live in different repositories and states · everything they share crosses through AWS, never through git
AWS account · the only shared surface
publishes · names, ids, ARNs, no secrets
env from facts · exit if missing
image tags · never a tfvars edit
terraform/ · network, EKS, IAM, edges, data stores
ci/infra · roles + CodeBuild of both pipelines
S3 · three keys, one per root
Application roles are never admin and cannot read the foundation state or its secrets · foundation applies happen only from the operations repository
